question: Can a reference-fitted mixture preserve form distinctions absent from observed record length?
outcome: On 144 frozen common-length generated conditions, fixed mixture recovers 82 maps and reference selection 79, compared with the earlier selector's 70. At reference size 400, zero/.35 shared mass each give 24/24 under mixture and selection, compared with 22/24 earlier. A collapsed-profile smoothing control gives 21/24 and 22/24. All68,014 primary checks, 4,433 assignment duals, 289 control checks and 72 final checks pass.
challenge: Three components are supplied as a prior, finite EM budgets leave 178 starts at their iteration limit, and six failed maps score below truth. The full 132,193,239-byte result exceeds GitHub's blob limit.
remedy: Keep the post-outcome same-record comparison explicit, verify penalized reference objectives separately from mapping likelihood, add a matched collapsed-profile control and preserve all candidates. Store the original locally and track eight lossless hashed gzip chunks with a refusing-to-overwrite reconstruction helper.
retry_when: A frozen form-count rule, changed encoded-mixture estimation, larger declared search budget or fresh uncertain-boundary systems supply a new comparison.
